"""Reviewed teaching reference for static Python Sphinx document layout."""
from lxml import html

def extract(data):
    tree = html.document_fromstring(data)
    bodies = tree.xpath("//div[@role='main' and contains(concat(' ',normalize-space(@class),' '),' body ')]")
    if len(bodies) != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected one Sphinx main body')
    body = bodies[0]
    titles = body.xpath('.//h1')
    if len(titles) != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected one h1')
    clean = lambda node: ' '.join(node.text_content().replace('¶','').split())
    result = dict(title=clean(titles[0]), blocks=[], metadata=[], excluded=[], warnings=[])
    for node in body.xpath('.//p|.//h2|.//h3|.//h4|.//pre|.//table|.//ul|.//ol|.//dl'):
        if node.xpath('ancestor::pre|ancestor::table|ancestor::ul|ancestor::ol|ancestor::dl'):
            continue
        text = clean(node)
        if not text:
            continue
        item = dict(kind='subheading' if node.tag in {'h2','h3','h4','dt'} else 'paragraph', text=text, xpath=tree.getroottree().getpath(node))
        if node.tag == 'table':
            item.update(kind='table', rows=[[' '.join(cell.text_content().split()) for cell in row.xpath('./th|./td')] for row in node.xpath('.//tr')])
        result['blocks'].append(item)
    result['warnings'].append('static_dom_only_no_ocr_or_javascript; code_and_lists_classified_as_paragraph; whitespace_normalized')
    if body.xpath('.//img'):
        result['warnings'].append('images_present_pixels_not_extracted_completeness_unknown')
    return result

"""Reviewed teaching reference for SQLite static fancy-document layout."""
from lxml import html

def extract(data):
    tree = html.document_fromstring(data)
    bodies = tree.xpath("//div[contains(concat(' ',normalize-space(@class),' '),' fancy ')]")
    if len(bodies) != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected one SQLite fancy body')
    body = bodies[0]
    clean = lambda node: ' '.join(node.text_content().split())
    title = tree.xpath('//title')
    result = dict(title=clean(title[0]) if title else '', blocks=[], metadata=[], excluded=[], warnings=[])
    for node in body.xpath('.//p|.//h1|.//h2|.//h3|.//h4|.//pre|.//table|.//ul|.//ol|.//dl'):
        if node.xpath("ancestor::*[contains(concat(' ',normalize-space(@class),' '),' nosearch ')]|ancestor::pre|ancestor::table|ancestor::ul|ancestor::ol|ancestor::dl"):
            continue
        text = clean(node)
        if not text:
            continue
        item = dict(kind='subheading' if node.tag in {'h1','h2','h3','h4','dt'} else 'paragraph', text=text, xpath=tree.getroottree().getpath(node))
        if text.startswith('This page was last updated on '):
            item['kind'] = 'updated_at'
            result['metadata'].append(item)
            continue
        if node.tag == 'table':
            item.update(kind='table', rows=[[' '.join(cell.text_content().split()) for cell in row.xpath('./th|./td')] for row in node.xpath('.//tr')])
        result['blocks'].append(item)
    result['warnings'].append('static_dom_only_no_ocr_or_javascript; code_and_lists_classified_as_paragraph; whitespace_normalized')
    if body.xpath('.//img'):
        result['warnings'].append('images_present_pixels_not_extracted_completeness_unknown')
    return result

"""Current-conversation AI candidate v2; static Sina article shell only."""
import re
from lxml import html


def extract(data):
    tree = html.document_fromstring(data)
    titles = tree.xpath("//h1[contains(concat(' ',normalize-space(@class),' '),' main-title ')]")
    bodies = tree.xpath("//div[@id='artibody']")
    if len(titles) != 1 or len(bodies) != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected one main-title and one artibody')
    body = bodies[0]
    result = dict(title=' '.join(titles[0].text_content().split()), blocks=[], metadata=[], excluded=[], warnings=[])

    def record(node, kind):
        clone = html.fromstring(html.tostring(node))
        for junk in clone.xpath('.//script|.//style|.//noscript'):
            junk.drop_tree()
        return dict(kind=kind, text=' '.join(clone.text_content().split()), xpath=tree.getroottree().getpath(node))

    def visit(node):
        if not isinstance(node.tag, str) or node.tag in {'script','style','noscript'}:
            return
        classes = set((node.get('class') or '').split())
        item = record(node, 'paragraph')
        text = item['text']
        if 'appendQr_wrap' in classes or node.get('id') == 'app-kaihu-stock':
            item['kind'] = 'promotion'
            result['excluded'].append(item)
            return
        if 'article-editor' in classes:
            item['kind'] = 'editor'
            result['metadata'].append(item)
            return
        if (node.tag == 'p' and body.xpath('./p') and node is body.xpath('./p')[0] and
                re.fullmatch(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff0-9]{2,20}记者\s+[\u4e00-\u9fff·]{2,8}', text)):
            item['kind'] = 'author'
            result['metadata'].append(item)
            return
        if node.tag == 'p' and text.startswith('专题：') and node.xpath('.//a'):
            item['kind'] = 'topic_navigation'
            result['excluded'].append(item)
            return
        if node.tag == 'p' and re.fullmatch(r'[（(]?文章来源[:：].+?[）)]?', text):
            item['kind'] = 'source'
            result['metadata'].append(item)
            return
        if node.tag == 'table':
            rows = [[' '.join(c.text_content().split()) for c in r.xpath('./td|./th')]
                    for r in node.xpath('.//tr')]
            if text:
                item.update(kind='table', rows=rows)
                result['blocks'].append(item)
            return
        if node.tag in {'p','h2','h3','h4','li','figcaption'} or 'pictext' in classes:
            if text:
                item['kind'] = ('caption' if node.tag=='figcaption' or 'pictext' in classes else
                                'subheading' if node.tag.startswith('h') or 'align-Center' in (node.get('cms-style') or '').split() else 'paragraph')
                result['blocks'].append(item)
            return
        if text and node.tag in {'div','section','details'} and not node.xpath('.//p|.//table|.//li|.//h2|.//h3|.//h4|.//figcaption|.//div'):
            result['blocks'].append(item)
            return
        for child in node:
            visit(child)
        if text and not len(node):
            result['warnings'].append('unhandled_text_node:'+item['xpath'])

    for node in body:
        visit(node)
    result['warnings'].append('static_dom_only_no_css_visibility_javascript_or_ocr')
    if body.xpath('.//img'):
        result['warnings'].append('images_present_pixels_not_extracted')
    return result
